init_policy_gradient: initialize a PolicyGradient object with entropy ratio and gradient clipping arguments
compute_policy_entropy_error: compute policy error and entropy error for a batch of actions and policies
compute_one_policy_entropy_err: compute log policy, policy error, and entropy error for a single policy action pair
register_backward_hook: register a backward hook on a tensor to clip gradients by a specified norm
feed_policy_gradient: run one iteration of policy gradient using Q values, policies, actions, and stats
